name: Wall Surface Projection & Texture Mapping
definition: Projects a 3D block face to 2D screen coordinates, handles X/Y clipping, calculates UV mapping with perspective-correct interpolation, applies per-face shading, and draws pixels.
summary: Wall Surface Projection & Texture Mapping renders 3D volumes by projecting axis-aligned block faces to 2D screen coordinates, differing from standard slicing by using manual pixel iteration on discrete voxel faces instead of hardware fragment shaders.
